note: S16: exfil.py became a mirror facade over exfil_url_rules (the URL rule tables), exfil_oauth (the OAuth endpoint set and shape diagnostics) and exfil_bash (the data-egress command gate). The URL classifier, the blocked-link records, the URL redactor, the OAuth credential diagnosis and the IMDS check stay defined in the facade; every other public name it bound before the split is served from its owner or still bound by its own import.
